boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors just beyond Mississippi State University, each with a specific, source-backed reason to look closer.

cards.title: Walk the Cotton District streetscape
cards.subtitle: Maxwell Street corridor, Cotton District
cards.notes: Start on Maxwell Street and look closely at the district’s redevelopment, which preserves the former mill-area setting beside campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent historic district shaped from a former cotton-mill area.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Starkville identifies the Cotton District as adjacent to Mississippi State and describes its redevelopment from a former cotton mill site and workers’ neighborhood.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor district; use public streets and respect private residences and businesses.

cards.entity_name: Cotton District Arts Festival & Taste of Starkville
cards.title: Plan for the arts festival
cards.subtitle: Maxwell Street corridor, Cotton District
cards.notes: Check the event listing before going; the annual festival includes a juried exhibit, crafts, live music, children’s activities, and a 5K.
cards.short_summary: An annual Cotton District event centered on art, crafts, music, and family activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The official destination page says the annual festival includes a juried art exhibit, arts and crafts, live music, children’s activities, a 5K, pet parade, and plant show.
cards.source_title: Cotton District Arts Festival & Taste of Starkville | Visit Starkville
cards.access_notes: Annual event; confirm the current date, program, and any ticketed activities before visiting.

cards.title: See a community-theatre production
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor, downtown Starkville
cards.notes: Look up the current production and reserve ahead if needed; the Playhouse hosts a four-production season at 108 East Main Street.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street playhouse with a recurring community-theatre season.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Starkville states that Starkville Community Theatre presents four productions each season at its Playhouse at 108 E. Main Street.
cards.access_notes: Performance availability and admission vary by production; consult the theatre’s current schedule.

cards.title: Eat at a long-running Main Street café
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor, downtown Starkville
cards.notes: Use the café’s current ordering page to check service status, then visit its listed location at 211 East Main Street.
cards.short_summary: A casual eatery operating from a named Main Street address.
cards.evidence_claim: Starkville Cafe’s official site lists its location as 211 E Main St., Starkville, and describes it as a casual eatery.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; check the official ordering page for current hours and availability.

cards.title: Build a pita to order
cards.subtitle: West Main Street corridor, downtown Starkville
cards.notes: Choose from the location’s menu or customize a pita, then use the official page for current ordering and daily service details.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street counter-service stop with customizable pitas.
cards.evidence_claim: Pita Pit’s official Starkville location page lists 104 West Main Street and describes handcrafted, customizable pita options.
cards.source_title: Pita Pit Starkville | Official Location Page
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; verify current hours on the official location page.

cards.title: Choose bagels, coffee, or gelato
cards.subtitle: University Drive corridor, Grand Junction
cards.notes: Stop at 509 University Drive for the business’s listed bagels, coffee, grilled cheese, açaí bowls, and gelato offerings.
cards.short_summary: A University Drive food stop with both breakfast and sweet options.
cards.evidence_claim: Dolce’s official site lists its 509 University Drive location and identifies bagels, coffee, grilled cheese, açaí bowls, and gelato among its offerings.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; the official site posts current hours by day.

cards.title: Order from the Academy Road menu
cards.subtitle: Academy Road corridor, near campus
cards.notes: Use the official location page to find the Starkville restaurant at 504 Academy Road, then check its current menu before going.
cards.short_summary: A named Academy Road restaurant location in Starkville.
cards.evidence_claim: Oby’s official locations page lists its Starkville restaurant at 504 Academy Road.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; confirm current service details directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Browse a Saturday market
cards.subtitle: Russell Street corridor, Fire Station Park
cards.notes: Visit on a scheduled Saturday to browse produce, plants, baked goods, and artisan work at Fire Station Park near University Drive.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal Saturday market bringing vendors to Fire Station Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The official market page says it brings local produce to Fire Station Park on Saturday mornings and provides visitor access information from University Drive.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal event; confirm the current market date and vendor schedule. Goods are sold by vendors.

cards.title: Follow the public-art mural route
cards.subtitle: University Drive corridor and nearby downtown streets
cards.notes: Use the mural destination as a starting point, then walk public sidewalks along University Drive and the connected downtown corridors.
cards.short_summary: A documented public-art destination spanning several downtown-adjacent streets.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Starkville identifies public art murals along University Drive, Russell Street, Lampkin Street, and Louisville Street.
cards.access_notes: View from public rights-of-way; individual murals may be on private building exteriors.

cards.title: Add a local-history stop
cards.subtitle: Fellowship Street corridor, between campus and downtown
cards.notes: Check the museum’s current visitor details and make time for its local-history exhibits on the corridor linking campus with downtown.
cards.short_summary: A local-history museum positioned between Mississippi State and downtown Starkville.
cards.evidence_claim: Mississippi State’s Starkville guide identifies the Oktibbeha Heritage Museum as conveniently located between campus and downtown Starkville.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current opening hours and any admission information with the museum before visiting.
